changes: Platform-owned runtime wiring; polling retains task metadata, caches wakers and coalesces wakeups; completed task membership and method wake queues are reclaimed; native execution does not install the IC panic hook.

Method records own their wake queues, eliminating the secondary table and duplicate task context field; bulk cancellation clears stale wakeups before dropping futures, preserving destructor-spawned tasks.
Use standard Vec task lists and retire the direct SmallVec dependency after installed benchmarking; the maintainer prioritizes production Wasm size over small-method allocation savings.
Tail task removal uses Vec::pop without scanning; non-tail removals preserve stable membership/cancellation order. Slot generations, wake routing and destructor placement are unchanged.
reviewed_upstream_history: 2.0.0 tracking/protected/migratory contexts and 1.x stale-waker/trap-recovery changes retained; local wake-routing and membership defects reproduced and covered by native/installed regressions.
